title: PMI回落与科技抛售压制总量风险，流动性操作和周末业绩提供结构观察
summary: 10月制造业PMI降至49.3，10月30日AKShare盘中快照显示A股跌家数3466、科创50跌3.00%，港股相对偏强；周五美股纳指跌2.86%、费半跌7.2%，周日夜期指小幅反弹。TCL科技、长飞光纤、屹唐股份仅列条件关注，赛力斯与停牌的TCL中环列回避。

关键词云图

PMI回落 美股科技抛售 A股宽度偏弱 港股相对强势 短端流动性 TCL科技业绩 光通信分歧 半导体设备扩产 汽车盈利压力 重组停牌 排行渐进展示 乌镇AI议题
利好利空中性w1-w5表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
宏观
10月制造业PMI降至49.3
国家统计局数据显示，生产指数49.8、新订单49.4；大型企业PMI为50.2，中小企业分别为48.4和47.5，总量需求偏弱。来源：国家统计局。
结构
高技术与装备制造仍处扩张区间
官方解读显示高技术制造业PMI为51.3、装备制造业为50.6，电子通信及航空航天等生产与新订单指数不低于53，结构好于总量。来源：国家统计局。
政策
隔夜逆回购延续至11月2日，重点是平滑资金面
央行已安排10月21日至11月2日开展隔夜逆回购、每日上限1万亿元；这是短端流动性管理，不等同于全面宽松。来源：上海市金融办转述央行公告。
产业
乌镇峰会11月2日启幕
议题包括AI开源生态、智能体互操作、具身与空间智能；政策与会议热度需等待订单和A/H价格确认。来源：中央网信办。
市场
A股宽度偏弱，港股盘中相对占优
10月30日AKShare盘中快照显示A股1805涨、3466跌、144平，中位跌0.87%；恒指涨1.88%、恒科涨1.26%，港股862涨、862跌、1080平。
美股
Intel引发半导体与AI硬件去风险
周五Intel跌约30%，纳指跌2.86%、费半跌7.2%；AMD、Nvidia、Broadcom、Micron等普遍下跌，A/H芯片与算力链开盘先看承接。来源：Reuters。
夜盘
周日夜美股期指小幅反弹，未扭转周五技术破坏
截至周日夜可得延迟行情，道指、标普500和纳指100期货约涨0.3%、0.4%和0.6%；Brent亚洲早段约跌1.7%至111.60美元，反弹暂属风险缓冲。来源：IBD延迟行情。
业绩
TCL科技利润增长，周末披露后尚待确认
前三季归母净利润51.2亿元、同比增68.06%，扣非净利润增70.96%；10月30日收4.50元、涨0.90%，但报告周末披露，不能把此前价格当公告后确认。来源：巨潮资讯。
业绩
长飞光纤高增长与负价格反馈并存
第三季营收93.16亿元、归母净利润32.03亿元；10月30日报表盘后披露前，A股收252.88元、跌7.57%，H股收96.15港元、跌4.99%，叠加美股光通信链回撤，只列条件关注。来源：上交所公告。
项目
屹唐股份拟投180亿元建设集成电路装备基地
项目聚焦干法去胶、快速热处理、干法刻蚀及等离子表面处理；10月30日收17.39元、涨1.93%，公告后交易反馈仍待周一验证。来源：公司公告镜像。
业绩
赛力斯利润质量与现金流承压
前三季归母净亏损2.97亿元、扣非净亏损37.44亿元、经营现金流净额-145.11亿元；A/H股10月30日分别跌2.73%和2.79%，列为回避。来源：上交所。
停牌
TCL中环与中国稀土筹划重组并停牌
两家公司均自11月2日开市停牌，方案仍处筹划、关联交易及审批存在不确定性；停牌状态本身不构成可执行多头信号。来源：TCL中环公告、中国稀土公告。

美股夜盘行情总结

现金收盘
现金收盘
10月30日标普500跌1.82%、纳指跌2.86%、费半跌7.2%，Intel跌约30%；这是A/H科技开盘的主要负面基准。
当前期指
当前期指
周日夜延迟期指小幅反弹：道指约+0.3%、标普500约+0.4%、纳指100约+0.6%；反弹幅度不足以抵消周五跌幅，且亚洲早段Brent约跌1.7%。
A/H映射
A/H映射
行业Top5中的抵押贷款金融+5.90%、化学制品+4.41%以及概念榜页岩油/天然气走强，更多是美股内部防御与能源轮动；对A/H只作方向观察。半导体与光通信的负面价格反馈优先级更高。

盘前结论

事实：总量景气和A股宽度偏弱，周五美股科技遭大幅抛售；港股在10月30日盘中相对占优。

判断：基准情景是指数风险偏好受限、结构性事件驱动。流动性操作提供短端缓冲，但不能替代盈利与价格确认。

执行：TCL科技、长飞光纤和屹唐股份只做条件关注；赛力斯和停牌的TCL中环回避。若开盘科技链继续弱于大盘，所有条件关注均降级。

重点个股关注

TCL科技
SZ.000100
条件关注

事实与状态：前三季归母净利润51.2亿元、同比增68.06%，中环领先第三季实现经营性盈利；10月30日收4.50元、涨0.90%，但报告周末披露，现价尚未确认。

确认条件：周一开盘后守住4.50元附近并强于深证成指/电子板块，且半导体材料业务改善得到量价承接。

风险与失效条件：光伏业务仍供需失衡，资产负债率66.6%；若跌破前收且弱于电子板块，取消关注。

长飞光纤
SH.601869 / HK.06869
条件关注

事实与状态：第三季营收93.16亿元、归母净利润32.03亿元，经营现金流改善；周五A/H分别跌7.57%和4.99%，且报告盘后披露，负价格反馈不能忽略。

确认条件：A股收复252.88元、H股收复96.15港元并持续强于通信设备，才从观察升级。

风险与失效条件：美股光通信与半导体链仍处去风险；若低开后无承接，继续回避追涨。

屹唐股份
SH.688729
条件关注

事实与状态：拟投180亿元建设集成电路装备基地，聚焦去胶、热处理、刻蚀与等离子处理；10月30日收17.39元、涨1.93%，公告后价格尚待验证。

确认条件：开盘后守住17.39元并强于科创50/半导体设备，同时等待项目资金、建设节奏与订单能见度。

风险与失效条件：资本开支规模大、兑现周期长，且周五费半重挫；跌回17.06元附近前收下方则失效。

赛力斯
SH.601127 / HK.09927
回避

事实与状态：前三季归母净亏损2.97亿元、扣非净亏损37.44亿元、经营现金流净额-145.11亿元；周五A/H分别跌2.73%和2.79%。

再评估条件：等待销量、扣非利润和经营现金流同步改善，并出现A/H持续相对强势。

风险与失效条件：零部件成本、研发投入和销量下滑继续压制利润质量，当前不包装为多头。

TCL中环
SZ.002129
回避

事实与状态：筹划购买中环领先少数股权并自11月2日起停牌；前三季归母净亏损45.56亿元，交易方案仍不确定。

再评估条件：复牌后再核对交易定价、摊薄/协同、审批和真实价格反馈。

风险与失效条件：停牌期间不可交易，光伏供需失衡与关联交易不确定性突出，不将重组预期当作可执行推荐。

板块轮动看板

相对强势港股指数10月30日盘中强于A股；美股行业榜以抵押贷款、化学制品和油气钻探居前。
事件驱动TCL科技业绩、屹唐扩产、乌镇AI议题提供局部催化，但均需周一价格确认。
压力方向高估值芯片、光通信与汽车盈利链；费半-7.2%和A股宽度偏弱提高开盘门槛。
验证信号观察电子/通信能否强于科创50，以及TCL科技4.50元、长飞A/H前收、屹唐17.39元能否守住。

逻辑链

PMI与AKShare宽度显示总量需求和A股风险偏好偏弱，指数不具备无条件追高基础。
周五美股科技与半导体大跌，令A/H芯片、服务器和光通信先面对估值与情绪传导。
短端流动性安排、乌镇会议和周末业绩只能提供结构性缓冲，必须通过周一开盘价格检验。
因此只保留3个条件关注，并对负现金流、停牌和负价格反馈标的明确回避。

风险雷达

制造业PMI、生产与新订单均低于50，总量景气回落。
周五费半跌7.2%，科技链可能出现跨市场低开与去估值。
AKShare为10月30日盘中快照，不是11月2日实时开盘数据；所有结论需开盘更新。
行业榜末页超时，Bottom5不可得；已发布的Top5不代表全榜无弱项。
重组停牌、项目投资与周末业绩均存在审批、融资、摊薄和执行风险。

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 shows attention/importance, not percentage change.
Major news
Macro
October manufacturing PMI falls to 49.3
NBS reported production at 49.8 and new orders at 49.4; large firms were at 50.2 while medium and small firms were at 48.4 and 47.5, showing weak aggregate demand. Source: NBS.
Structure
High-tech and equipment manufacturing remain in expansion
The official commentary put high-tech manufacturing PMI at 51.3 and equipment manufacturing at 50.6; electronics/communications and aerospace production and new orders were at least 53. Source: NBS.
Policy
Overnight reverse repos run through Nov 2 to smooth funding
The announced Oct 21-Nov 2 operations have a CNY1tn daily cap. This is short-end liquidity management, not blanket easing. Source: Shanghai financial authority summary of the PBOC notice.
Industry
Wuzhen Summit opens on Nov 2
Topics include open-source AI, agent interoperability, embodied intelligence and spatial intelligence; policy attention still requires order and price confirmation. Source: CAC.
Market
A-share breadth is weak while Hong Kong outperforms intraday
The Oct 30 AKShare snapshot showed 1,805 up, 3,466 down and 144 flat in A shares, with a -0.87% median; Hang Seng rose 1.88% and HSTECH 1.26% while Hong Kong breadth was 862/862/1,080.
US
Intel triggers de-risking across semiconductors and AI hardware
Intel fell about 30% Friday, the Nasdaq 2.86% and the SOX 7.2%; AMD, Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron also dropped, setting a high bar for A/H chips and compute. Source: Reuters.
Overnight
Sunday-night US futures rebound modestly
Delayed Sunday-night quotes had Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures up about 0.3%, 0.4% and 0.6%; Brent was down about 1.7% near $111.60 in early Asia, only a partial risk buffer. Source: IBD delayed quotes.
Results
TCL Technology profit rises; weekend disclosure awaits confirmation
Nine-month attributable profit was CNY5.12bn, up 68.06%, and adjusted profit rose 70.96%. The stock closed Oct 30 at CNY4.50, up 0.90%, but that pre-report price is not post-disclosure confirmation. Source: CNINFO.
Results
YOFC's earnings surge clashes with negative price feedback
Q3 revenue was CNY9.316bn and attributable profit CNY3.203bn. Before the report after Friday's close, the A/H shares fell 7.57%/4.99%; together with the US optical-chain retreat this remains watch-only. Source: SSE filing.
Project
E-Town Semiconductor plans a CNY18bn equipment base
The base focuses on dry strip, RTP, dry etch and plasma surface treatment. Shares closed Oct 30 at CNY17.39, up 1.93%; post-release trading confirmation is still pending. Source: company filing mirror.
Results
SERES faces earnings-quality and cash-flow pressure
Nine-month attributable loss was CNY297m, adjusted loss CNY3.744bn and operating cash flow -CNY14.511bn; the A/H shares fell 2.73%/2.79% Friday, making it an avoid. Source: SSE.
Suspension
TCL Zhonghuan and China Rare Earth suspend for planned restructurings
Both suspend from the Nov 2 open while terms remain preliminary and approval/related-party risks remain; a suspension is not an executable bullish signal. Sources: TCL Zhonghuan, China Rare Earth.

US overnight summary

Cash close
Cash close
On Oct 30, the S&P 500 fell 1.82%, Nasdaq 2.86% and SOX 7.2%, while Intel lost about 30%; this is the main negative baseline for the A/H tech open.
Current futures
Current futures
Delayed Sunday-night futures rebounded modestly: Dow about +0.3%, S&P 500 +0.4% and Nasdaq 100 +0.6%. The move does not erase Friday's loss, while Brent fell about 1.7% in early Asia.
A/H mapping
A/H mapping
Mortgage Finance +5.90%, Chemicals +4.41%, plus Shale Oil and Natural Gas among concept leaders show US internal defensive/energy rotation, not direct A/H stock triggers. Negative chip and optical price feedback takes precedence.

Pre-open conclusion

Facts: Aggregate activity and A-share breadth are weak, US tech sold off sharply Friday, while Hong Kong outperformed intraday on Oct 30.

View: Base case is constrained index risk appetite with selective event-driven setups. Liquidity operations cushion the short end but do not replace earnings and price confirmation.

Execution: TCL Technology, YOFC and E-Town are conditional watches only; SERES and suspended TCL Zhonghuan are avoids. Continued tech underperformance at the open downgrades all watches.

Priority stock setups

TCL Technology
SZ.000100
Conditional watch

Facts and status: Nine-month attributable profit was CNY5.12bn, up 68.06%, and Zhonghuan Advanced posted Q3 operating profit. Shares closed Oct 30 at CNY4.50, up 0.90%, but the weekend report has no current confirmation.

Confirmation: Hold around CNY4.50 after Monday's open and outperform the Shenzhen/technology benchmarks while semiconductor-material improvement receives volume support.

Risks/invalidation: Solar remains oversupplied and group leverage was 66.6%; a break below the prior close while lagging electronics cancels the setup.

YOFC
SH.601869 / HK.06869
Conditional watch

Facts and status: Q3 revenue was CNY9.316bn and attributable profit CNY3.203bn with better operating cash flow. A/H shares fell 7.57%/4.99% Friday and the report came after the close, so the negative feedback remains relevant.

Confirmation: The A share must reclaim CNY252.88 and the H share HKD96.15 while sustaining relative strength versus communications equipment.

Risks/invalidation: US optical and chip chains remain in de-risking mode; no early bid after a gap-down keeps the name in avoid territory.

E-Town Semiconductor
SH.688729
Conditional watch

Facts and status: It plans a CNY18bn chip-equipment base focused on dry strip, RTP, etch and plasma treatment. Shares closed Oct 30 at CNY17.39, up 1.93%, but post-release confirmation is pending.

Confirmation: Hold CNY17.39 and outperform STAR 50/chip equipment after the open, while funding, construction cadence and order visibility improve.

Risks/invalidation: Large capex and a long ramp face Friday's 7.2% SOX drop; a move back below roughly CNY17.06 invalidates the setup.

SERES
SH.601127 / HK.09927
Avoid

Facts and status: Nine-month attributable loss was CNY297m, adjusted loss CNY3.744bn and operating cash flow -CNY14.511bn; A/H shares fell 2.73%/2.79% Friday.

Reassessment: Wait for simultaneous improvement in deliveries, adjusted profit and operating cash flow plus persistent A/H relative strength.

Risks/invalidation: Component costs, R&D intensity and lower sales pressure earnings quality; it is not presented as bullish.

TCL Zhonghuan
SZ.002129
Avoid

Facts and status: It plans to buy remaining minority interests in Zhonghuan Advanced and is suspended from Nov 2. Nine-month attributable loss was CNY4.556bn and terms remain uncertain.

Reassessment: After resumption, verify transaction pricing, dilution/synergies, approvals and real price feedback.

Risks/invalidation: It cannot be traded during suspension; solar oversupply and related-party uncertainty prevent treating the deal as an executable recommendation.

Sector rotation board

Relative strengthHong Kong outperformed A shares in the Oct 30 snapshot; Mortgage Finance, Chemicals and Oil & Gas Drilling led US industry rankings.
Event-drivenTCL results, E-Town capex and Wuzhen AI themes offer selective catalysts that all require Monday price confirmation.
Pressure areasHigh-multiple chips, optical connectivity and auto profitability face the 7.2% SOX drop and weak A-share breadth.
Validation signalsWatch whether electronics/communications beat STAR 50 and whether TCL CNY4.50, YOFC prior closes and E-Town CNY17.39 hold.

Logic chain

PMI and AKShare breadth show weak aggregate demand and A-share risk appetite, arguing against unconditional index chasing.
Friday's US tech and semiconductor rout transmits valuation and sentiment pressure into A/H chips, servers and optics.
Short-end liquidity, the Wuzhen event and weekend results provide only selective offsets that must pass Monday's price test.
Therefore only three conditional watches remain, while negative cash flow, suspensions and adverse price feedback are explicit avoids.

Risk radar

Manufacturing PMI, production and new orders are all below 50.
The SOX fell 7.2% Friday, risking cross-market gaps and de-rating in technology.
AKShare is an Oct 30 intraday snapshot, not Nov 2 live opening data; every setup needs an opening update.
The industry last page timed out, so Bottom5 is unavailable; published Top5 does not imply the full ranking lacks weak groups.
Restructurings, suspensions, capex and weekend results carry approval, financing, dilution and execution risk.
